_doc: cctvdet: shared cases for shopbox/detect_rules.py (tests/test_detect_rules.py) and app/lib/cctv/detect_rules.dart (app/test/cctv_detect_parity_test.dart); tamper cases also run against core/logic/cctv_rules.assess_still (backend). Expectations are written by hand from the rule text. Patch {pattern h|v, lo, hi} = 16x12 stripes (h: row%2, v: column%2; even = lo).

cases.name: crowd_three_for_a_minute
cases._doc: cctvdet3: a dip below crowd_n shorter than CROWD_KEEP_S (t=80) keeps the crowd; a longer one (t=80..105) ends it

cases.name: vehicle_line_missed_check_and_jitter_on_the_line
cases._doc: cctvdet3: a car missed for one check still counts (TRACK_JUMP_CAP within TRACK_COAST_S); a car standing ON the line (within CROSS_MARGIN) never counts
